Appearance

Stocky, weathered man with calloused hands and a perpetual scowl. Looked like someone who built his way up from nothing.

What We Know

A merchant in the Merchants Guild who had a dispute with Guildmaster Alistair Goldman. The party spoke with him during a guild quest — he claimed Goldman was corrupt. Eventually went to the authorities with evidence after Julie convinced him.

First Impressions

Guarded and suspicious — took a lot of convincing before he'd trust strangers.

Interactions

  • Party investigated him for Goldman — ended up siding with him instead
  • Found dead after falling from a window — reported in the newspaper
